d: Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.
Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.
Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.
Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.
Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.
An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.
Mark has been tricked into selling his soul in order to save a little girl's life. But the Devil has another agenda: acquiring Jonathan's soul.
Factory workers ignore ground-water contamination, even though it is making their children sick. As a result, Jonathan takes drastic measures to force them to face the facts.
A minor-league baseball team never wins, so Jonathan and Mark set out to help them. They also come to the aid of an elderly vendor who has been kicked out of the stadium.

st: The Smile in the Third Row
d: The lead actor in a Broadway play claims that God is attending the show's performances, sitting in a third-row orchestra seat.
The teenage daughter of Mark's friend tries to find her biological mother. It may tear the family apart.
Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.
Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance. He defends the young artist with a facial deformity who has been accused of assaulting a blind girl.
Jonathan and Mark go to work at a football team. They learn that one of the players has been getting drugs from the team doctor.
A homeless boy wishes that someone would love him.

st: Close Encounters of the Heavenly Kind
d: Jonathan and Mark help a bullied orphan whose eccentric grandfather is in danger of losing him to a heartless social worker.
Mark switches places with an attractive movie star who has a low opinion of men.
